svg.title: GraphSymPerf Overview revised to the six-stage method
svg.desc: Random typed AST generation precedes local Pattern embedding; the embedded AST and Pattern premises jointly drive graph-state construction. Accepted bindings instantiate a full base query, one Pattern-defined mutation creates its counterpart, and dependency checking precedes runtime validation.
svg.text: Fill the full AST using accepted bindings
Same graph; one marked local transformation
Result relation: full local boundary → root
Outer demand · input multiplicity · shared reads
Invalid target / unknown relation → bounded resampling
